# Physical refinement of the selected recursive complex layer

Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance,
including source-analysis agents. Apache-2.0.

## Claim and retained hypotheses

I implement the whole-call algorithm in PR2287, including the root return.
I retain that contribution's quantified domain: precision p>=2,
d=floor(p^(997/1000)), K=floor(d^(1/500)), D<=d selected axes at
rho+jK, 0<=rho<K, complete spectator fields and arbitrary outer rows.
Each record has r=2^Theta(p/d) Gaussian fields, with fixed positive constants;
the address and descriptor length is O(p). At the root I accept coefficients
in 2^-p Z[i] in the unit disk. At internal entries I allow arbitrary
correlations and the incoming heights specified below.

Under the retained selected native identities, chronological hosting proof,
and completed ordinary B1/C0 interchange contract, I obtain the same conditional
O(V d^(599/600)) normalized-layer bound as PR2287. I give a Count-driven
physical interpreter for that construction, rather than a new exponent.
I retain the source claims about elementary tape operations and the
noncircular ordinary backend. I have not formalized their refinement or
executed the selected O(73,2)/GL64 payload.

I distinguish three kinds of evidence. I check the complete finite selected
instruction inventory and fixed-prime admission. I execute reduced complete
controllers against independent arithmetic oracles. I give the following
induction and cost argument for the full source-relative construction.
The reduced executions do not prove its universal refinement.

## Cover and complete global dispatch

I index the fixed O(73,2) cover by lexicographic row order. For an orthonormal
prefix, let c be the remaining characteristic vector and t the remaining
dimension. I count candidates by the affine equations specifying orthogonality
and norm one. For odd t>1, I exclude c: after choosing c I would have a
nonzero alternating complement and could not complete an orthonormal basis.
For even t I exclude nothing; for t=1 I accept the final row.

Thus I have 2^(t-1)-[t>1 and t odd] choices, followed by the same count in
dimension t-1. I count bit-prefix completions by exact binary elimination,
then rank/unrank one row at a time. This proves the indexing induction and
the familiar cardinality

    Gamma = 2^1296 product(i=1..36)(2^(2i)-1).

I check the complete small groups through dimension 5 and bounded 73-dimensional
round trips. I do not enumerate Gamma. These matrices and ordinals belong
to fixed finite control, independent of numerical input precision.

In `selected_binding.py` I bind all 482 chronological events, 144 local calls,
101,376 owner entries and 10,002 emitted helper charts. For a common cover d
and owner chart sigma, I select the physical owner g=d sigma^-1. The archive
stores columns of sigma; I use them as rows of its inverse. I gather the
whole owner packet, apply P_d^-1 and the pulled-back data entrance alignment,
execute the complete local program, then apply its exit alignment and P_d.
I apply no data-family Pauli to helper packets.

For an idle child I use the exact unconsumed axis suffix and complete its
orthogonal chart. I perform its child call before X_(g theta). I retain 6,822
nonzero translations after hosting consumed the positive-rank part.
I keep bridges at their physical family/cover positions, perform terminal
Y translations before (X,Y)->(Y,-X), and finally use the output-coordinate
mask delta(g)_i=(wt(row_i(g))-1)/2 mod2. I do not multiply that final mask
by g a second time.

I retain the selected common-label, untouched-window and tensor identities
from PR2287 and the archived sources. Those identities establish that this
complete global dispatch returns C^(tensor 73f) on each live row. I check
the compiled child histogram against

    {1:349604,2:60192,3:62585,4:20448,5:11808,7:7,8:1152,48:4866}.

I account for 70,032 fixed subgroups per cover. Empty identity corrections
need no payload scan; I preserve their place in the finite schedule.

## One active node and physical returns

I store a node rectangle in the order

    [P][R][front][H][H][before][e*K][after][H][back][r Gaussian fields].

In `bank_packets.py` I scan the complete current bank to gather the selected
family/cover packets. I keep the current bank until I have constructed the
complete replacement, then commit that replacement. I preserve the entire
unused-row and spectator rectangle. At smaller global groups I leave the
unused roles in the fixed 704-packet inventory empty.

In `machine.py` I stop at e<73 or e^1000<d. Otherwise I process the leftmost
e mod73 selected chunks with the exact leaf, retain them as spectators and
set f=floor(e/73). I divide the row count by L=14336 Gamma and require a
positive exact quotient U. At a rank-r child I set e'=rf, R'=U and append
(73-r)fK bits to `after`. I preserve the complete packet volume v=V/L.
I keep d,K,G,H and the coefficient grid global.

Before descent I close scalar, leaf, monomial and native scratch. I encode
the parent's finite root/event/subgroup/cover/PC/target/rank header and all
Count descriptors, then park the fixed roles on a physical stack. I encode
body symbols in four bits and use separate role/frame delimiters. I copy
the child capsule into the same active roles and continue the interpreter
loop. I retain no Python recursive continuation.

At return I move the child's complete result to a protected tape, erase the
active roles, restore one parent frame and check its exact child instruction.
I replace that child packet and resume at the saved next PC. I reconstruct
the finite group from source control alone. Strong induction on e closes
the endpoint: r<=48<73, previous children have completed endpoints, and the
current child receives only its own copied input and descriptors. I never
read a buried ancestor during a child. The parent may contain correlated
dirty families, and its private centres follow the literal COPY/CLEAR word.

At root return I require an empty continuation stack and empty owned work.
I preserve the borrowed source and descriptors, including after the tested
short-packet and insufficient-row rejections. I make no promise to recover
from arbitrary corruption of an inherited primitive's private state.

## Root planning, normalization and rounding

In `root_plan.py` I compute the PR2287 reservations with encoded arithmetic:

    G=4 ceil(log2 p)+6, H=dG,
    D0(e)=0 for e<73, otherwise 1+D0(48 floor(e/73)),
    q0=ceil(log2 L)D0(d), qF=ceil(2H/K), qB=ceil(H/K), Q0=q0+qF+qB.

I obtain floor rational powers from the inherited ceiling root by comparing
with the exact target; I saturate at target+1 so that I retain strict
overshoot information. I close the fixed expression temporaries before
entering recursive execution.

I also discharge the Compact repair inequality at each fast input. Put
l=ceil(log2 p). Since Q0>=qF+qB>=3H/K=3dG/K, the conditions D>Q0 and
D<=d give K>3G. Therefore

    K>=3G+1=12l+19>8l+16=G+4l+10.

I meet the sufficient inequality in the credited PR3055 Compact proof
without adding an execution cutoff. I also have 3H<dK<=p^.998994<=p,
so the reserved compact fields fit the address domain. At f=1 I bypass
Compact; below the ordinary fitted range I use its elementary fallback.
I still require the long-record hypothesis to absorb descriptor/repair
setup. For shorter records I retain the unabsorbed primitive invoice.

For D<=Q0 I use the direct leaf. Otherwise I process the first q0+qF and
last qB axes, reserve the complete row range R0=2^(q0K), and pad it once
to a multiple of L^D0(d). Since R0>=L^D0(d), I increase volume by less than
two. I keep outer rows and the left spectator field as complete prefixes.
I carve two front H-bit fields and one back H-bit field, then call Machine
on the remaining D-Q0 chunks. After its endpoint I verify that padded rows
are zero before removing them. At each child U retains the required stock,
by D0(rf)<=D0(e)-1. I restore the original address rectangle.

I choose Delta=2^210000 d once and represent components with
h=p+2Delta+3 bits on the grid2^-(p+Delta). I append Delta low zeros and
Delta+1 sign-extension bits to each p+2-bit input component. In `root_layer.py`
I execute

    S_D, C^(tensor D), S_D, multiplication by b^D,
    b=(1-i)/2,

on that one grid. I reuse PR3127's Count-driven one-pass normalization.
The retained identity gives H0^(tensor D), where H0=[[1,1],[1,-1]]/2.
I truncate each component toward zero only after the whole root. For a
negative quotient with discarded nonzero bits, I add one before checking
output headroom; checking before that correction would reject valid boundary
values. I preserve the unit disk and incur error below sqrt(2)2^-p, since
H0 has row L1 norm one and componentwise truncation decreases absolute values.

## Inventory, height, time and space

I allocate 678 tapes outside Machine, 3,348 complex-controller tapes excluding
the shared native backend, and

    6(C+1)+Wb+Sb+2q^2+417

native tapes, with C=2^24,Wb=28416,Sb=662. I include the two numerical-codec
tapes that use dictionary storage. In total I own 2q^2+100696823 physical
tapes; the caller supplies eight input ports. I allocate no extra tape
inventory per cover matrix, scalar literal or recursive depth. I count
fixed source tables separately from numerical work. I do not reuse PR2287's
720-slot estimate for this implementation.

The two local words require 80,397 and 80,421 scalar microinstructions.
Across 80 forward and 64 backward calls, plus their standalone COPY/CLEAR,
I charge 11,581,648 passes per cover before bridges, within PR2287's
20,936,640 scalar allowance. Each Horner prefix has height at most
max(bit_length(|a|),k), within the credited source charge. Monomial movements
and unit phases add no coefficient height.

I retain s=1041408 Gamma,E=2^100000,B=s+E. With the actual inventory, I
check the enlarged conservative literal allowance below E. Before the one
unfinished child, I charge previous children only by their completed widths.
The PR2287 induction therefore remains

    A(e)<=8e at a leaf;
    A(e)<=A(48f)+sf+E internally;
    A(e)<=2Be, and A_layer<2^210000 d.

I check the strict integer guard inequalities. Hence each exact half discards
zeros on the common grid, and signed headroom covers each interpreted
coefficient prefix. I interpret native bit-work as coefficients only after
the completed bit operation returns. I round no child result.

I charge complete bank scans, replacement copies and parking, in addition
to primitive work. Their finite multiplicities change constants. With the
retained ordinary exponent tau=.99830289, I obtain per-node nonrecursive
cost O(V((e log p)^tau+1)). I use the unchanged child histogram and the
retained strict sigma=.99833 moment. With cutoff beta=.001 I obtain internal
exponent .99832997289, leaf exponent .99833167 and reservation exponent .998.
Each lies below249583/250000<599/600, leaving room for the logarithmic factors.
I retain the long-record hypothesis to pay polynomial descriptor and per-row
preparation costs. I claim no new moment or multiplication exponent.

At a child cut I park at most V+712(V/L) payload bits and19 metadata/header
roles. I use 732 role delimiters and one frame delimiter. Along a branch the
payload volumes are V/L^j, so parked payload occupies at most

    4(1+712/L)V/(1-1/L).

I also charge the root's retained input copy, replacement bank, child capsule
and protected output. With the inherited Compact/native space contract and
long records, I use O_q(V)+F_q space. I prove this for occupied/visited tape
regions, not garbage-collector behavior. The Tape emulator never shrinks its
backing list on clear; across repeated roots its allocation follows the largest
historical call. At blank return I establish erased work, not reclaimed host
memory.

## Evidence limits and next obligations

I execute complete reduced recursive C fixtures, including two nested levels,
and direct/reduced-fast normalized roots. I compare them with independently
written Gaussian and rational Walsh oracles. I check selected compilation,
small complete covers, signed truncation boundaries, retained borrows and
named cleanup failures with assertions disabled.

I have not executed a production-guard root, the complete O73 payload or the
GL64 native factory. I have not emitted a literal universal transition table
or obtained independent human or proof-assistant validation of this refinement.
I retain the native, hosting, analytic-transfer and outer integer-packing
obligations at their credited scope. A reviewer should examine the refinement
induction and source-relative factory before using this implementation in a
complete multiplication theorem.
